capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Quick web lookup (rough, not cross-checked). Gross capacity.

chemistry.notes: Both EV9 packs NMC (SK On) per EV Seekers; EV Database lists NMC for the 99.8 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Manual switch plus conditioning timed to a fast charger set as waypoint/destination (MV1 2026 manual; MV1 is the EV9 per the en_US specs page). Cited page is the UK copy; the en_US copy of this page was not found. Manual says the feature applies only to vehicles with a battery heater.

dc_max_kw.notes: US Kia spec sheet via dealer: 210 max DC (99.8 kWh pack). InsideEVs measured 216 kW on a 2024 GT-Line. Replaces an unsourced 240 kW.

curb_weight_kg.notes: Guide Auto lists 2,650 kg (5,842 lb) for the Canadian Land AWD with GT-Line Package (99.8 kWh, 21-inch). Page label may read "Weight"; presumed curb weight.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 75 mph (about 121 km/h) steady, temperature not stated, 21-inch 285/45R21 wheels (match this trim), battery-side vs wall-side not stated | Car and Driver 75-mph highway range test of the 2024 EV9 GT-Line AWD (99.8 kWh, same generation, pack, motors and wheels), 240 mi vs 270 mi EPA. 2.4 mi/kWh -> 1000 / (2.4 x 1.609344) = 259 Wh/km. Syndicated via AOL; original Car and Driver page not fetched. Not attached to other EV9 trims (19-inch wheels or different motors). Also seen: ArenaEV 130 km/h, 11 C, 33.2 kWh/100 km (332 Wh/km); outside 110-120 km/h so not used.

wheels.notes: US dealer spec sheet for GT-Line; Canadian trim mapped by name.
